title: Sudoku Solver - Solution
intuition: Write a program to solve a Sudoku puzzle by filling the empty cells. Empty cells are '.'
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
time_complexity: O(9^(m)) where m is number of empty cells
common_mistakes: Use backtracking. Find an empty cell. Try placing numbers 1-9. If placing number is valid, recurse. If it fails, backtrack.
